fullText.simplified:
B和G

    我懂了。虽然我没有对人说过，但我也经常想一雪。她的眼睛，她的笑，我都想。所以，看到北亮的时候，我觉得我见过他的眼睛，这也是因为他是一雪的弟弟。照片里的人是我，大学的时候，很多同学都有我的照片，我不知道一雪也有我的照片。
    一雪喜欢我？我想了很长时间，觉得这不是真的。
    我说：“一雪不会喜欢我。”
    “姐姐喜欢你。”北亮说，“你看照片的后面。”
    我看到照片的后面有两个字，“B”和“G”，很好看，写得很漂亮。
    “这两个字是一雪写的？什么意思？”我问。
    北亮说：“我觉得这两个字是名字。姐姐姓高，GAO，G就是GAO。B是你的姓，你姓白，B就是BAI。所以，‘B’和‘G’就是你和姐姐。姐姐喜欢你。”
    我的眼睛红了。这是真的吗？一雪喜欢我？大学的时候就喜欢了？

sentence_translations: I understood. Although I hadn’t told anyone, I often thought about Yixue. Her eyes, her smile, I missed it all.
So, when I saw Beiliang, I felt that I had seen his eyes before because he was Yixue’s younger brother.
The person in the photo was me. When I was at college, many classmates had photos of me.
I didn’t know that Yixue also had a photo of me.
Yixue liked me? I thought about it for a long time and felt that this was not true.
I said, “Yixue couldn’t have liked me.”
“My older sister liked you,” Beiliang said, “Look at the back of the photo.”
I saw two letters on the back of the photo, “B” and “G”, which were very nice-looking and beautifully written.
“These two letters were written by Yixue? What do they mean?” I asked.
Beiliang said, “I think these two letters are names.
My older sister’s surname is Gao, GAO, and G is for GAO. B is your surname. Your surname is Bai, and B is for BAI.
So, ‘B’ and ‘G’ are you and my older sister. My older sister liked you.“
My eyes turned red. Was this true? Yixue liked me? She liked me when we were at college?
